title: cobolwork site file
description: cobolwork.site.json: the facts about an estate that no repository holds. lib/site.mjs reads it; a key it does not read is reported under summary.siteWarnings, and a key opening with an underscore is a note for people.

version.description: The site file version. A file without one is read as version 0, which holds the same keys as version 1.

productionQualifiers.description: Dataset qualifiers that name production data, matched as whole leading components.

productionJobPaths.description: Paths of jobs allowed to touch production.

nonProductionJobPaths.description: Paths of jobs that are not production jobs.

systemNames.description: Names of production systems, which the recon rules look for in source.

vendorPacks.description: Vendor rule packs to load, by name.

allowUnvalidatedPacks.description: Load a vendor pack that has not been validated.

runtimeVersions.description: The version of each runtime the estate runs, by product, so an advisory against it can be matched.

internalReaderDds.description: DDs in the CICS region's JCL that are SYSOUT=(class,INTRDR).

internalReaderQueues.description: Transient-data queues that reach the internal reader.

compilerOptions.description: The estate's default compiler options, as its compile procedure sets them.

restrictedDatasets.description: Dataset prefixes only a privileged user may read.

surrogateUsers.description: Users a job may legitimately run as.

superuserIds.description: Ids privileged in UNIX System Services: UID 0, or a holder of BPX.SUPERUSER.

openTransactions.description: Transactions any user can start. A COBOLWORK_REACH extract overrides it.

restrictedTransactions.description: Transactions a control restricts. A COBOLWORK_REACH extract overrides it.

openJobs.description: Jobs any user can submit. A COBOLWORK_REACH extract overrides it.

restrictedJobs.description: Jobs a control restricts. A COBOLWORK_REACH extract overrides it.

privilegedTransactions.description: Transactions that run with elevated authority. A COBOLWORK_REACH extract overrides it.

privilegedJobs.description: Jobs that run with elevated authority. A COBOLWORK_REACH extract overrides it.
